sloka: पद्मोत्पलयुता भान्ति पूर्णाः परमवारिणा ।क्षौद्रं दधि घृतं लाजा दर्भाः सुमनसः पयः ॥२-१५-८॥
transliteration: padmotpalayutā bhānti pūrṇāḥ paramavāriṇā ।kṣaudraṁ dadhi ghṛtaṁ lājā darbhāḥ sumanasaḥ payaḥ ॥2-15-8॥

translations.english: Honey, curd, ghee, puffed grain, darbha grass, flowers and milk were arranged. Wellmannered courtesans adorned with all kinds of ornaments (stood in position).
